newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT-Dutch chartists mainly upbeat on AEX index.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Dutch chartists mainly upbeat on AEX index.

text.p: Dutch chartists remain largely optimistic on the short-term prospects for the AEX index this week, though some still see a correction in the works.

The AEX share index closed at 771.57 last Friday, up 18.95 points from the prior week's close. The AEX started Monday strongly, with the index briefly popping up to an all-time high of 779.23, before settling back amid thin trade.
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance

ING Barings -- The AEX is building up momentum for a likely upward breakout above its all-time high at around 779. Last week's low at around 750 is still above 740, the upper side of its former trading range 700-740. Indicating a higher bottom with a rising trend, started from its lows at 700. New highs in money flow are already pointing to likely new highs on the price chart. The A/D ratio is rapidly improving suggesting possible new leadership in the market. Improving and favourable technicals confirms the continuation of the uptrend by breaching the 779 level. As this might occur, a further rise towards the 795-800 resistance level should be likely.
Horizontal support comes in at the 764 level and only a close below the 749 level would violate the downtrend, indicating more downside.

MeesPierson -- The short term technical outlook for the AEX is rather limited. We expect the resistance at 779 will be too strong. Wall Street will reach its old time high at 7112 and from that level we expect some correction. Both the dollar and the Bunds charts aren't too inspiring either.

JAAD -- ADX tells us that the trend is picking up (it seems the divergence between the Index and its RSI around 700 really did its job well). Most indicators show favourable weather for the next days.

Rabo Securities -- We arrived at the all-time high which we are actually testing today. A clear break of this resistance would fuel another rally and the existing uptrend will probably accelerate from that point on. Our first price target is currently at 790, but we think it is a matter of time before this target will be reached.
AEX 800 will probably be another round number but not a real resistance.

ABN AMRO - Contrary to the down move which was possible last week, the AEX has broken its all-time-high, in the beginning of this week. This fact, accompanied by the readings on the RSI showing a low risk situation, makes us focus on the 800 level within the near future. Within the longer-term uptrend, the AEX has gained strength of momentum. An intra-day test of the former top of 779 which can turn into support, is still possible.

However prices around these levels are nice levels to increase exposure on the long side, when these levels prove to be support. However, in case the test doesn't hold, an aggressive exit-stop level at 775 is advised. Even in this scenario, the medium term direction remains strongly up. So focus up, don't even think about short-term short strategies.
